scope: Volume3 chapters10–14:12 redrawn diagrams plus4 existing nativeTikZ diagrams;16 actual book pages
review_method: Viewed every mapped actual book-page PNG individually, not contact sheets; checked actual typography,node/edge scale,group boundaries,clipping,CJK axes,local scenes/digits,caption/prose agreement and float placement.
frozen_input_policy: No writes to figures/,tex/ or build products; only this review record was written.
